record host load with every T8 result - the 47-tok/s outlier was host contention + pinned KV, not the card

sm80 DFlash2 runtime Xid 31 reports on driver 610.43.02 (HyperQwen issues 72 and 98, both closed): sustained decode wedged the card in minutes at any k, while SPEC=mtp ran 9h+; a third box on driver 610.57.04 could NOT reproduce either fault (docs/reproductions/cmp-170hx-64gb.md, same sha-69ba4d0 image + W4A16-AutoRound-fast) - prefer 610.43.03/610.57.04 for T8 and treat any Xid 31 as fatal (the smoke guard stops the run and the gate counts it)
W4A16/W8A16 Marlin checkpoints wedge GA100 at LOAD time with Xid 31 (vendored cmp-170hx-vllm warning) - only the pinned AutoRound + DFlash2 path is receipt-chained
